title: Halt hears radio reports of beams into weapons storage area

tellings.quote: he heard on the radio that he had that security policeman back at the the weapon storage area were reporting an object hovering above the weapon storage area sending down beams of light

plain: In 1980, an officer named Charles Halt heard over his radio that security police at the weapons storage area of RAF Bentwaters, an air base in England, were reporting an object 'hovering above the weapon storage area sending down beams of light'. The researcher Robert Hastings, who studies UFO reports at nuclear bases, tells Michels this as Halt's account. If true, something unknown was taking an interest in where the weapons were kept.
